outcome: Types of late-onset Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR) (Type I and II)
cohort: The study participants were 442 fetuses with late-onset fetal smallness (SGA) after week 34.
finding: Two thirds of late-onset fetal smallness occurs without hemodynamic changes, and among those with anomalies, distinct progression patterns of umbilical and cerebral Doppler abnormalities define two varieties of late-onset FGR (Type I and II) with similar clinical outcomes but different birth weight centiles.
birth_weight: Birth weight centiles (2.51 SD 2.91 vs 3.97 SD 3.17)
